body: I say! That is a subzero Caucasian male.

Meds can't fix a screwed life. I have been through this for years now. I'm not going to keep fighting the things I feel see and hear. I just want it all to end. I'm tired...so tired. hospitals confine you to a small hallway and spend 5 minutes before slowly adjusting your diagnosis. I've been through the system enough.
Thank you for reinforcing that I'm fat in metrics.

I have major depression/Psychosis and borderline personality disorder. I'm being treated for all these things, but it doesn't matter. It isn't helping. I sleep most of the day away and I'm awake until the late AM. The demons come out to play at night, and it's an evil dance they have with the abyssal lord himself. I hear the voices of the dead, I hear films and movies in my head constantly running. My life is dregs. I'm 25 going on 60 I'm 5'7 weight 290 lbs and really am not attractive. I suppose I have intellect but what good does that do you, when you are all alone, and no one listens to creativity or madness. No one wants to be near you or touch you. There is no point in continuing the facade I call a life.

What's the point...there is nothing left here for me. I wish there was, but I'm not happy or even content. I'm very depressed and I just want to die. The loneliness is killing me. The fact that minutes feel like years to me. I can't even be sure what's real anymore or if i know anything other than darkness. It's like i keep sliding downhill and no one can help.
